The search didn't settle the question. Sources disagree on the newest React version, and none is clearly dated after mid-2026.

- **19.2.7 is the most likely latest.** One aggregator lists 19.2.7 as released 1 June 2026. A release tracker shows a React release on 14 July 2026 without naming the version, and a dependency report treats 19.2.7 as current. (Latest Stable 19.0.7 Released 01 Jun 2026 is the headline on that same page, which conflicts with its own list.)
- **19.2.6 is the version several sites name.** endoflife.date lists 19.2.6 (06 May 2026) as the latest for React 19, and a French tutorial targets version 19.2.6, published by the Meta team on 6 May 2026.
- **Major version:** React 19 is the current major line. The latest major release is supported with new features, bug and security fixes.

To confirm, run `npm view react version` in a terminal, which queries the npm registry directly. To update a project, install the latest versions of the react and react-dom packages by running npm install react@latest react-dom@latest.

content.text:
The latest major line is still **React 19**, specifically the 19.2 series. I couldn't pin down the exact patch version.

- **19.2** came out October 1, 2025. It added `Activity` and `useEffectEvent`, among other things.
- **Patch releases** have continued since then. Sources disagree on the newest one: endoflife.date lists 19.2.6 (May 6, 2026), while another aggregator lists 19.2.7 (June 1, 2026).
- **Security fix:** a critical React Server Components vulnerability was patched in 19.0.1, 19.1.2 and 19.2.1. If you're on an older patch, upgrade.
- **Recent news:** the newest blog post I found (February 2026) is about the React Foundation launching under the Linux Foundation, not a new React version.

I found no sign of a React 20. To get the exact current version, run `npm view react version`. To upgrade, run `npm install react@latest react-dom@latest`.

Sources:
- [React Versions](https://zh-hant.react.dev/versions)
- [React Blog](https://react.dev/blog)
- [endoflife.date/react](https://endoflife.date/react)
- [versionlog.com/react](https://versionlog.com/react/)
